name: rasuvaeff/property-testing-docs-api-workspace
description: Not a package: installs the two adapters alongside this checkout of core so docs/scripts/reflect-api.php can reflect all three src/ trees through one autoloader. Deliberately kept out of core's own composer.json — installing it must never change what `composer why testo/testo` reports for core (Stage F exit criterion). The two adapter constraints and the path version below are part of a core release: a caret on 0.x pins a minor, so a stale one makes the weekly docs rebuild re-reflect adapters several lines behind their latest release, forever.
